note: Where the tool scout looks for new AI tools (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md, 'Tool scout'). Besides the Hacker News and GitHub APIs (and Product Hunt with PRODUCTHUNT_TOKEN), it reads these makers' own news feeds every hour for launch posts ('Introducing …', '… is now available'); robots.txt decides, a disallowed feed is skipped and named in the run summary. Never add other AI-tool directories: their selection is their work. blockedDomains: registrable domains that are never published; a tool already in quarantine on such a domain is taken offline at the next check.
